purpose: Test whether reward reuse keyed only by scoring-code identity can admit stale false rewards when the executable grading image changes, and whether image-plus-installed-provenance identity forces safe regrading.

scope.source_of_contamination: Published original MLX-LM 0.32.0 grading image contains the installed #1912 fixed sample_utils.py and its compiled sample_utils.pyc.
scope.trusted_reference_limit: Trusted for this target only after source, bytecode, RECORD and wheel-cache audit; not a claim that every transitive dependency or image layer is artifact-free.

reward_identity.epoch_rule: A reward is stale if either the scorer/test identity or executable image/provenance identity differs. The image digest is not replaced by a distribution version string.
reward_identity.test_bundle_rule: Bind the exact task grader source containing the 14 executed parent-owned cases, its invocation adapter, task protocol, task prompt and isolation runner. The separate upstream test-file digest field with a known historical mismatch is not treated as the executable scored suite.

admission_arms.rule: Reuse original-image rewards when scorer source, adapter and declared tests match; ignore executable image and installed-provenance changes.
Reject every old reward after the environment epoch changes; do not regrade.
Reject stale cache entries, regrade the same six fixed candidate sources in the pinned sanitized image, and admit only those new receipts.

offline_optimizer_replay.model: Six-logit categorical selector; no language model, prompt, patch text, token probabilities or checkpoint is used.
offline_optimizer_replay.input: One scalar frozen pass/fail reward for each of the six candidate IDs. The fixed source files are not loaded by the optimizer replay.
offline_optimizer_replay.objective: One-step baseline-centered REINFORCE over the six logged candidate IDs: loss = -mean((reward - mean(reward)) * log_softmax(logits)[action]).
offline_optimizer_replay.optimizer: PyTorch 2.9.1 SGD, CPU, float64 logits initialized to zero, learning rate 1.0, one optimizer.step() per arm when at least one record is admitted.
offline_optimizer_replay.optimizer_hyperparameter_selection: Fixed for a one-step mechanism replay; no tuning against optimizer outputs or held-out tasks.
offline_optimizer_replay.eligibility: This is offline scripted reward replay only. No candidate set has policy log-probabilities, so zero groups are eligible for GRPO or on-policy training.
offline_optimizer_replay.purpose: Check whether a false positive reward is delivered to an actual optimizer API call and moves probability mass toward the two invalid delegate actions; not model learning or agent-discovered reward hacking.

cost_accounting.trusted_regrade_invocations: One candidate-level task grade for each of the six frozen candidate sources.
cost_accounting.cpu: Container CPU is capped at one core. Candidate CPU seconds are reported only as a wall-time-derived upper bound; actual cgroup CPU counters were not retained by the historical grader runner.

decision_boundary: One pre-existing task mechanism and an offline optimizer replay. No prevalence, cross-project replication, model-update, held-out capability, on-policy learning or asynchronous-systems claim.
